TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with “NaMo Run – For Viksit Delhi” on 28.09.2025, traffic restrictions/diversions will be in place on Vikas Marg, ITO, JLN Marg, Connaught Place & adjoining roads.

📍 Diversions: Delhi Secretariat, BSZ Marg, IP Flyover, JLN Marg, Kamla Market R/A, Minto Road, Rani Jhansi Rd, Panchkuiya Rd, Pusa Rd
📍 No heavy/commercial vehicles from 6–9 AM
📍 No parking on restricted stretches 
📍 Use alternate routes: Ring Road, Outer Ring Road, Rani Jhansi Flyover & peripheral roads
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels
